title: Website redesign in preview
body: A new typography-first design, an Apps directory and a refreshed logo are being reviewed on a preview deployment. The production website is unchanged until approved.

title: Learning guides expanded
body: Guides on SHA-256 verification, multilingual AI review and recognising real app releases were published, with an in-browser checksum tool.

title: Privacy and transparency revisions
body: Draft privacy notices were corrected for accuracy and a Bahasa Malaysia draft notice was added. Legal texts remain drafts pending review.

title: Chat workspace preview
body: The /chat/ workspace was published as a clearly labelled local demo with scripted replies. No live AI is connected.
